_doc: Gait constants shared by lib/staging/walk.ts and tools/pipeline/staging.py: step_m — step length, m; ramp_s — acceleration and stop of a walking figure, s; step_min — never fewer steps per path segment (a step and a closing step: the figure stands on both feet); pace — allowed steps per second on the steady part for every walk pace (production rule 4; slower than 0.9 the legs step as in slow motion).
